cards.name: Espeon GX
cards.notes: Only a PSA 10 makes money (~+$417); a 9 loses about $60. About 1 in 4 PSA copies gets a 10, so the rough average per copy is about +$48 at a $75 fee and about +$98 on a ~$25 bulk tier. Rainbow secret rares show surface scratches easily. The $99.99 listing in your cart is almost double what copies have been selling for (~$54).

cards.name: Charizard GX
cards.notes: Only a PSA 10 makes money (~+$336); a 9 loses about $290 because a PSA 9 sells for less than a raw NM copy. About half of PSA copies get a 10, so the rough average per copy is only about +$8 at a $75 fee, basically a coin flip. Grade only copies that look perfect; otherwise selling raw is safer.

cards.name: Shining Mew
cards.notes: Not a condition flip: MP copies have actually been selling for $110–$123, almost the LP price, so buying MP and selling LP loses money after fees. Grading is the play: a PSA 10 makes about $984, and about 30% of PSA copies get one. A 9 loses ~$51. Rough average per copy: about +$241 at a $75 fee. Prices are trending up (NM was ~$150 three months ago).

cards.name: Shining Rayquaza
cards.notes: Small condition flip: MP (~$75) to LP (~$105) is only about +$16 after eBay fees. Grading is the better play: a PSA 10 makes about $909, and about 29% of PSA copies get one. A 9 loses ~$53. Rough average per copy: about +$216 at a $75 fee. Check the dark borders for whitening. Oct 2026 scan pick for MP → LP: MP → LP $55.17 → $105.07 (+90%). LP → NM doesn't pay to a vendor; keep it an MP → LP flip. Card # 56/73.

cards.name: Pikachu & Zekrom GX
cards.notes: Condition flip: LP (~$117) to NM (~$212) is about +$67 after eBay fees; MP rarely sells. Grading: only a PSA 10 makes money (~+$444), a 9 loses ~$92, but over half of PSA copies get a 10. Rough average per copy: about +$175 at a $75 fee.
